# pvecli pool import

Import pools from a JSON file.

```text
pvecli pool import [FILE] [OPTIONS]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `FILE` | JSON file to import. |

## Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-f`, `--force` | Skip existing pools without warning. |
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
